selection_reason: Modern, complete balanced round-robin league listed in the current open-data catalog and unused by this project; selected from match-level coverage before acquiring player events or calculating qualifying outcomes.
pattern_A: Existing frozen original environment-first 2+ shots rule.
pattern_B: Pattern A plus previous-five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.
decision_policy: No threshold changes, result-based exclusions, or dataset substitution after player-event acquisition. Preserve every sample, exclusion and unknown.
limits: Women's football is a different population; this tests portability and is not direct validation of a men's MLS betting rate.
The same 2023/24 season and StatsBomb provider family as the WSL stress test may introduce common-era/provider dependence.
Historical lineup-time starters are treated as known; publication timing is not reconstructed.
